thread:
mira: Quick design check — I pushed an updated side-by-side regression diff in Figma (link above). Main concerns: toolbar density, compact diff keyboard nav, and scanline contrast on light theme. Can folks skim and call out any blockers?
sam: skimmed. overall 👍 but toolbar feels heavy on narrow screens. Can we collapse the Compare dropdown into a single icon + tooltip to save width?
olivia: agree on collapsing. also CTA copy: 'Approve selection' is too verbose in compact view. Suggest 'Approve' and 'Reject with reason' for the destructive action.
kevin: collapsing is doable. need to ensure keyboard + focus behavior is clear — icon needs aria-expanded/aria-controls and an accessible label. Example snippet: `button.icon[aria-expanded="false"][aria-controls="compare-menu"]` and menu gets role="menu".
mira: thanks @kevin. I'll update Figma to show the icon state and label.
olivia: accessibility nit: scanline highlight border (2px, #cfe8ff) fails contrast on light bg — should be stronger. Need 4.5:1 AA.
a11y-bot: Automated check: flagged low-contrast element in frame 03 (scanline border). Severity: medium. Recommendation: increase border color darkness or add 1px solid outline + 2px inner highlight.
sam: another thing — in mobile/narrow the diff summary truncates the change counts. Users want the counts visible. Propose an inline badge: "Changes 12" that stays visible even when space is tight.
kevin: badge works. Make it non-interactive and include aria-label="12 changes" so screen readers announce it. Confirming: badge won't be a button.
mira: noted. Action items: 1) collapse Compare into icon w/ visible focus ring 2) badge for change counts (non-interactive + aria-label) 3) CTA copy -> 'Approve' / 'Reject with reason' 4) update scanline border color to meet contrast.
olivia: UX concern about inline rejection reasons — we could let users expand a short 'reason preview' per diff row instead of forcing a full text field for every item. default collapsed, expandable on focus/hover.
sam: +1 to collapsed preview. keeps density but surfaces intent. Also microcopy tweak: change "Request review" -> "Ask for review" (easier to scan).
kevin: I'll prototype the collapsed toolbar + badge and wire up keyboard nav. Plan: add role/menu, keyboard handling, and aria announcements. I'll also add an a11y jest test asserting focus order. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
olivia: I'll draft 3 microcopy variants for the CTAs and the reason preview line and run a quick preference poll with content ops.
mira: awesome. @qa-bot can you add a regression test to cover compact-diff keyboard nav and approval flow with reject reason expansion?
qa-bot: Test task created: "compact-diff-keyboard-nav" and "approval-reason-expand" — scheduled to run on the next CI build.
kevin: quick implementation question — do we want the badge count announced as "12 changes" or "12 changed files"? which is clearer for users?
olivia: "12 changes" is concise and fine for most customers. if we detect file-level diffs we can say "12 files changed" in detailed mode.
sam: tiny visual nit: when the diff row is selected, the scanline + left gutter should not both use the same primary blue. Create slight hue difference to improve shape language.
mira: good call. I'll update the tokens in Figma.
kevin: starting PR now. I'll include the aria attributes example and unit tests.
olivia: I'll post microcopy options in this thread once ready.
mira: thanks all — updating Figma and linking PR when ready. will follow up with QA test links. :handshake:
